messages:
Nina: Kicking off blue->green for reply-proxy v2026.04.05-green, initial staged 8% global. change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. release notes: https://confluence.redwood/reply-proxy/2026.04.05 :rocket:
Deploy-bot: Deploy started (job=xyz321). Command: `rd-deploy start --service reply-proxy --version v2026.04.05-green --strategy bluegreen --staged 8%`
Deploy-bot: Router change queued: `routerctl set-weight reply-proxy green 0.08`
Hector: spotting small increase in p95 for sa-east1 (from 140ms to 220ms) at ~6m after start. errors low but latency tail up :thinking_face:
Jules: suggest hold global ramp. Can we apply a region lock for sa-east1 to keep it on blue and let other regions continue?
Nina: yes, apply region lock and add cookie affinity for sa-east1 to blue. Also bump canary healthcheck to 5m.
Deploy-bot: Applied region lock: sa-east1 green=0.00, cookie-affinity blue set. Global staged remains 8% elsewhere.
Hector: after lock, tail latency in sa-east1 stabilizing. other regions look fine.
Jules: I'm going to add a temporary router policy to prevent automated ramp >20% until we confirm memory and queue profiles. `routerctl set-policy reply-proxy auto-ramp-threshold 0.20 --ttl 3h`
Deploy-bot: Policy applied.
Nina: documenting: "partial canary: sa-east1 excluded due to tail latency; cookie-affinity applied; auto-ramp cap 20% TTL 3h". Creating follow-up ENG-6802 for runtime investigation.
Hector: recommend we re-run canary in sa-east1 with debug build after infra tune. For now, marking thread monitored for 1h.
Jules: ack.
Nina: thanks team, closing thread unless alerts fire.
